name: Moli
source:
The [url=https://vndb.org/c56687]protagonist[/url]'s childhood friend. She's happy to have reunited with him after several years. But Jasmine appears to be somewhat different compared to how she used to be. She is easily bullied by much younger children and even appears less mature than how he remembered her. Jasmine decides to show him a clearing in the forest where they used to play. In the center of a beautiful field of flowers is a large shed filled with nothing but books. In the pages of one of these books are secrets to a forgotten past. To pass the time, Jasmine begins to fold paper planes as they have used to do but the paper planes hold many secrets. After continuing to visit the secret place in the forest, he is told to stay away from there and the secrets of the past begin to unfold hidden inside of a paper plane that he holds. He must discover the truth from Jasmine but time is running out for her and she can no longer stay there.

[Edited from [url=http://www.otakuaniverse.com/index.php/visual-novels/479-season-of-12-colors-review]Otaku Aniverse Review[/url]]
